| Sum | $\sumto{i}{n} a_i = a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_n$ |
| [Induction](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/induction.html#def-proof-by-induction) | $P(b)$ and $\forall k \ge b, P(k) \Rightarrow P(k + 1)$ give $\forall n \ge b, P(n)$ |
| Base case | $P(b)$ |
| Inductive step | assume $P(k)$ (the inductive hypothesis), show $P(k + 1)$ |
